deadline_tie_note: When a deadline equals a call's duration, the asyncio dispatcher reports a timeout (the deadline event is scheduled before the wake event) while the threaded dispatcher reports a completion (the completion event is scheduled before the deadline event). Both are deterministic and documented; a caller that assumes one convention for both components will misread the boundary.
description: Propagation map: for each fault type (timeout, cancellation, partial failure, out-of-order completion), each component (asyncio dispatcher, threaded dispatcher, shell runner), and each injection point (at-issue, in-flight, at-completion), what happens at each stage (issued -> in-flight -> terminal -> collected), where a result can be lost, and where recovery happens. Every stage description is drawn from the observed matrix cell run named in the cell's evidence; counts are the measured correct-mode and naive-mode results.
timing_note: All ticks are virtual-clock ticks, not wall time, for the asyncio and threaded dispatchers. Shell times are real seconds; only completion order, exit codes, and output digests are asserted, never wall-clock thresholds.
